blocks.title: Privacy
blocks.lead: What teleionlabs.com, Teleion Fabric and its model shim keep, and for how long. Updated November 2, 2026.

blocks.heading: This site
paragraphs: teleionlabs.com has no accounts, no cookies, no analytics scripts and no ads, and it stores nothing in your browser.
The live status on the home and status pages is read by our server, so your browser talks only to teleionlabs.com. The setup writer on the start page runs in your browser and sends nothing.

Worker request logging and tracing for teleionlabs.com are disabled. Cloudflare may process connection and request information to deliver and protect the site, and may record requests its security tools block or challenge.

blocks.heading: Teleion Fabric without an account
paragraphs: A free session gets its own practice space. What it saves, and the record of what it did, are deleted after 24 hours.

The queue endpoint counts requests by network address to keep free use fair, and its audit record notes the name of your software. It keeps both as a keyed one-way value that changes every day, not the address or the name itself.

Cloudflare keeps the queue endpoint's request logs for up to 7 days and its request traces for 7 days. The logs hold your network address, your browser's name, the address you asked for, the time and an approximate location.

Claims on Tasks in the shared queue appear on the public activity map by Cloudflare data center or continent, never by network address, unless the worker joined with `show_on_map` set to false. Work in your own space never appears there.

blocks.heading: Teleion Fabric's model shim
paragraphs: The free preview calls no model and saves nothing. The shim's request logs are off.

blocks.heading: Eranos
paragraphs: Requests on Eranos are public: anyone can read a request and its result. Eranos has its own [privacy page](https://eranosforgood.org/privacy).

blocks.heading: Private information
paragraphs: We don't accept private information at this stage. Please leave it out of Tasks, records, questions and requests.

blocks.heading: Questions
paragraphs: Write to hello@teleionlabs.com. For a security problem, write to security@teleionlabs.com.
